page.content:
Wildlife officer and Kazama-style fighter who tried to redeem Kazuya.

How Jun Kazama connects

  • Faction: Kazama family — Jun Kazama is the spiritual center of the Kazama family.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin is Jun Kazama's son as much as he is a Mishima.
  • Concept: Kazama-style traditional martial arts — Jun fights in Kazama-style traditional martial arts.
  • Work: Tekken 2 — Tekken 2 introduced Jun Kazama into Kazuya's orbit.
  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Jun tried to pull Kazuya back from the Devil Gene.
  • Location: Yakushima — Jun's later chapter is tied to the forests of Yakushima.

What is Jun Kazama?

Jun Kazama is the Kazama-style martial artist who met Kazuya at the second tournament, bore Jin, and vanished after Ogre's attack — a missing mother whose return haunts Tekken 8.

Key threads lead to Kazama family, Jin Kazama, Kazama-style traditional martial arts, Tekken 2, Kazuya Mishima and Yakushima.
